code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and abnormal white cell differential with relative neutropenia, lymphopenia, monocytosis, and basophilia. Red cell distribution width is elevated, suggesting anisocytosis. Renal and liver function, electrolytes, and glucose are within normal limits. Findings may indicate bone marrow dysfunction or infiltration, chronic disease, or acute infection; clinical correlation and further hematological evaluation are recommended.
